Date: Jul 6, 2026
* 🔴 User stated: max guest count is 150; floral budget max $4,500; prefers minimalist gold geometric table centerpieces.
* 🟡 Researched vegetarian brunch options, botanical floral portfolios, and configured website RSVP automation.
* 🟢 User mentioned: cousin Thomas has severe peanut allergies.

Date: Jul 9, 2026
* 🔴 User stated: wedding hashtag is #ToHaveAndToHolt2026; rehearsal dinner at Harbor View Restaurant; photographer arrives two hours before ceremony.
* 🟡 Prepared acoustic indie dinner playlist, checked ADA-compliant transit, and reviewed pyrotechnics fire safety rules.

Date: Jul 12, 2026
* 🔴 User stated: catering headcount cutoff is Sept 1, 2026; morning getting-ready robes are emerald green silk; seating separates college friends from family.
* 🟡 Researched dried lavender florals, local welcome snacks (pretzels/cider), custom mountain ring engravings, and zero-proof botanical spritz.

Date: Jul 15, 2026
* 🔴 User stated: venue walkthrough is Aug 26, 2026; dietary restriction labels must be printed directly on place cards.
* 🟡 Checked sunrise photography rates, biodegradable leaf confetti, emergency kit items, amber uplighting, and 1965 convertible getaway car.

Date: Jul 19, 2026
* 🔴 User stated: ring bearer pillow must be vintage lace; welcome bags must include local craft beer and artisan chocolate; college friends grouped at table four.
* 🟡 Planned white rose and eucalyptus floral arches, acoustic cocktail setlist, black aprons for catering staff, and 45-minute sunset portraits.

Date: Jul 23, 2026
* 🔴 User stated: cake flavor is pistachio; videographer final payment due Aug 10, 2026; rehearsal dinner capped strictly at 35 guests at The Rustic Hearth.
* 🟡 Updated morning robes to pure mulberry silk, added midnight return shuttle, and ordered custom ceramic coaster favors.
* ✅ Confirmed gluten-free macaron tower addition with Sweet Treats Bakery.
</observations>
